structure: Part 2 read the ruling's preamble and the whole verbatim quote (lines 1-136) and sections (e) to (h), lines 375-495: (e) Commodities wait on MDM, claims 28-33; (f) Transporter management waits on requirements, claims 34-37; (g) Documents, claim 38; (h) Who owns the overview, check answers, declaration and confirmation, claims 39-42. Claims 28, 34, 38 and 39 are Sam's own decisions (points 2, 5, 4 and 7 of the quote); claims 29-33, 35-37 and 40-42 are the orchestrator's application of his principles, which the preamble says are not his rulings. This part claims Sam's decisions in the quote for points 2, 4, 5 and 7 as verbatim, each listed claim's rows and rules (orchestrator claims as inferred, quoting the listed claim's own words), and the gaps the quote leaves open.
